request_words: error kind: Http 0, Timeout 1, Connection 2, Network 3, Build/RetryLimit 4
status: original Http StatusCode 100..999, otherwise zero
effects: Output capacity is checked before any input read. Structural invalid and short calls preserve all buffers. Success writes exactly output[0..16], preserving request, empty workspace and output tail.
public_domain: All original bool policies, all u64 attempt/max_attempts, all original TransportError variants and every valid http::StatusCode including 600..999. Opaque payloads are never read or copied into native input.
hia_owns: Attempt-limit stop, original 429/500..599/transport decisions and checked next-attempt progression.
rust_retains: Original request construction, Future/response/error objects, backoff including random sampling and overflow policy, trace macro and sleep order. No new bounds or Send requirement; cancellation and callback semantics remain host effects.
scope: Linux x86-64 GNU opt-in retry control unit. Full HTTP/TLS/auth/SSE/WebSocket/provider/tool lifecycle and other platforms remain separate.
